name: Sericipterus
sum: Large, triple-crested rhamphorhynchine from the Late Jurassic Shishugou Formation of Xinjiang, China.
holotype: IVPP V14725 — Shishugou Formation (early Oxfordian), Junggar Basin, Xinjiang.
exceptional: First parietal crest reported in a non-pterodactyloid.
biology: Recurved, keeled teeth with cutting edges; large rhamphorhynchines like it are thought to have lived inland as predators of small tetrapods.
author: Andres et al. 2010

species.name: Sericipterus wucaiwanensis
species.author: Andres et al. 2010
